meta.title: Ethical Hacker
meta.tagline: Think like an attacker to strengthen defenses.
meta.description: Ethical hackers simulate real-world attacks to discover vulnerabilities before malicious actors. They use systematic methodologies to test systems, networks and applications, providing actionable remediation guidance.
